# Release Milestone

@id: milestone.release
@labels: milestone, p0
@depends-on: milestones/beta.md
@created: 2024-01-15

## Description

v1.0 release: polished, marketed, and ready to ship. Includes marketing materials, multi-platform builds, and launch preparation.

@agent-note: Trailer and screenshots needed early for store page submission. Launch day monitoring is critical for hot-fix response.

## Tasks

- [ ] Final polish
  - Polish budget: 2 weeks after feature freeze
  - Focus on first 30 minutes (first impression critical)
  - [ ] Visual polish pass
  - [ ] Audio mix and mastering
  - [ ] UI/UX refinements
  - [ ] Performance tuning
- [ ] Marketing materials
  - Trailer: 60-90 seconds showcasing gameplay variety
  - Screenshots: 5 minimum (1 per biome + boss fight)
  - [ ] Trailer video
  - [ ] Screenshots
  - [ ] Store page copy
  - [ ] Press kit
- [ ] Release preparation
  - Steam requires 2-week lead time for store page review
  - Test on: Windows 10/11, macOS 12+, Ubuntu 22.04
  - [ ] Build all platforms
  - [ ] Test on target hardware
  - [ ] Prepare patch pipeline
- [ ] Launch
  - Submit to itch.io first (faster approval)
  - Monitor Discord and Twitter for launch day issues
  - [ ] Submit to stores
  - [ ] Launch day monitoring
  - [ ] Community engagement
